name: gke-live deploy path + forge mode
description: The live GKE dogfood instance (app.warren.run, cluster warren-502318) deploys ONLY on releases (release.yml -> deploy-gke.yml workflow_call) or manual 'gh workflow run deploy-gke.yml -f deploy=true'. There is deliberately no push trigger (warren-8b5f). The gitignored deploy/k8s/overlays/gke-live/ comment claiming CI deploys every merge is stale. As of 2026-08-13 the instance runs WARREN_FORGE=app (GitHub App installation tokens, minted per operation); the static github-token secret key remains as the PAT-mode rollback: set warren-forge=github and rollout-restart.
